selectionRule: Accept only an explicitly listed full draught Guinness pint price; never substitute another beer
matchingRules: compatible name plus exact normalised postcode
compatible name plus nearest coordinates within 35 metres, with the next venue over 75 metres away
compatible name plus venue-specific website host and path
compatible name plus matching numbered street address
limitations: The directory is community-reported, not an official pub-menu source.
The source records do not expose a per-observation date, so freshness cannot be guaranteed.
Other draught beers are deliberately excluded because they are not comparable to the Guinness benchmark.
Unresolved or ambiguous directory pubs were deliberately not imported.
